subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, diagramas, entrevistas, curiosidades, dentre outros gêneros do campo investigativo, digitais ou impressos, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar o propósito comunicativo de gêneros investigativos como diagramas, entrevistas e matérias de curiosidade
components.description_en: Identify the communicative purpose of investigative genres such as diagrams, interviews, and curiosity pieces
components.cc_component_description: Identify the purpose of information presented in visual, quantitative, or oral media formats

components.description_pt: Planejar um texto investigativo colaborativamente, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema
components.description_en: Plan an investigative text collaboratively, considering the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Plan writing by considering purpose, audience, and the most significant ideas to convey

components.description_pt: Produzir um texto investigativo escrito ou digital com apoio de colegas e professor
components.description_en: Produce a written or digital investigative text with peer and teacher support
components.cc_component_description: Synthesize information from several sources to produce a written response to a research question

components.description_pt: Selecionar formato de gênero apropriado (digital ou impresso) conforme situação comunicativa
components.description_en: Select appropriate genre format (digital or print) based on communicative situation
components.cc_component_description: Select appropriate digital media formats to enhance a specific presentation's purpose and audience

cc_matches.description: Analyze the purpose of information presented in diverse media and formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) and evaluate the motives (e.g., social, commercial, political) behind its presentation.

Make strategic use of digital media (e.g., textual, graphical, audio, visual, and interactive elements) in presentations to enhance understanding of findings, reasoning, and evidence and to add interest.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.

Conduct short research projects to answer a question (including a self-generated question), drawing on several sources and generating additional related, focused questions that allow for multiple avenues of exploration.
